newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BRUSSELS BEL-20 INDEX UP 0.3 PCT AFTER START DELAY.
newsitem.headline: BRUSSELS BEL-20 INDEX UP 0.3 PCT AFTER START DELAY.

text.p: 0825 GMT - Brussels Bel-20 index up 7.75 points, 0.33 percent, at 2,380.92 after opening delayed twenty minutes due to technical glitch
* Retailer Colruyt leading gainer, surging to new record high at 17,975 francs after price weakness last week on back of annual results
* Insurer Royale Belge up 150 francs at 10,425 francs, after Echo newspaper at weekend reiterated speculation on sale to Dutch bank ING
